name: Marble Merge: Steal Brainrot Game 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Marble Merge: Steal Brainrot Game is a fast, addictive marble race and merge game powered by the chaotic universe of steal brainrot. Just like classic Watermelon-style merge gameplay, you spawn bowling balls, merge identical ones to create bigger and stronger levels, then drop them through the trapdoor straight onto the race track.
